context:
Goal: restart the flywheel, with plan refuters working for the coordinator.
Problem (rule): your ruling 111 a lets a cloud coordinator start only Plan, Explore and claude-code-guide agents, but main's decision plan-refuter says a refuter runs after each Plan agent. On #1971's head the guard refuses a coordinator's refuter, and changing 111 a's list needs your word.
Based on (read): #1971's Sonnet fix check failed on this one clash; nothing else was lost in its merge.
Based on (read): #2123 merges right after #1971 and needs a fresh review anyway.
Departs from: main's ruling 111 a (three agent types) — adds the refuter as a fourth.
Meanwhile: #1971 waits; other lanes go on.

options.how: #1971 lands as it is, after a fresh full round 3; #2123 adds the refuter to the coordinator's list.
options.label: Add the refuter in #2123
options.lose: Between the two merges, a coordinator's refuter is refused: a false alarm on a read-only agent, not a safety hole.

options.gain: No gap between the two merges.
options.how: A test-author, a builder, then a fresh round 3 on #1971.
options.label: Add the refuter on #1971 now
options.lose: One more build and review round on #1971.

options.how: Ruling 111 a stays at three agent types.
options.label: Leave the coordinator without refuters
options.lose: Goes against decision plan-refuter: a coordinator's plans get no refuter.

reply: Routed 13:11 CST Nov 9 to step coordinator-refuter-spawn (lane revive-1042, via the coordinator), roadmap 2e2d190de. #1971 lands after a fresh full round 3; #2123 adds the refuter.
title: Let a cloud coordinator start a plan refuter? Today your ruling 111 a allows it only Plan, Explore and claude-code-guide agents.
